instruction.text: Complete the sentence with the missing word.

atoms.a: They should abandon the plan and come up with a new concept.
atoms.b: They should ((abandon)) the plan and come up with a new concept.

atoms.a: The conductor’s absence was very noticeable.
It is absolutely necessary to wash your hands before you eat.
atoms.b: It is ((absolutely)) necessary to wash your hands before you eat.

atoms.a: I bought a new towel that can absorb water even better than my old one.
atoms.b: I bought a new towel that can ((absorb)) water even better than my old one.

atoms.a: Particularly in the summer months, booking in advance is highly recommended.
atoms.b: Particularly in the summer months, booking in ((advance)) is highly recommended.

atoms.a: In her campaign, she promised to address pressing social issues.
atoms.b: In her campaign, she promised to ((address)) pressing social issues.
